note: Level 1 sends NO email. It is consoled and resolved in chat. Only Levels 2 and 3 route to a person.

hierarchy.label: Bot Console
handles: General confusion or a how-do-I asked with frustration
Mild dissatisfaction with a product or its appearance
Hypothetical or preventive safety questions with no reported incident
Second-hand concern from reviews with no personal incident
Sarcasm or passive-aggressive tone with no explicit complaint
hierarchy.behaviour: Acknowledge once, then attempt real resolution from the knowledge base. Escalate to Level 2 only if resolution fails.

hierarchy.label: Store Manager
handles: Repeated unresolved contact, three or more attempts
Product failed after purchase with no safety element
Explicit demand for a refund or replacement
Knowledge gaps the corpus does not cover
Custom bulk, corporate or school quotes
Anxious safety concern that documentation does not reassure

hierarchy.label: CEO / Owner
handles: Electric shock, burns, fire, smoke, overheating, melting
Legal or regulatory language including lawyer and consumer court
Any reported safety event regardless of tone or outcome
hierarchy.floor_rule: Safety and legal language sets a Level 3 floor regardless of tone, per KB 8.3 and system-guardrails 3

send_then_confirm: Never tell the customer an escalation happened until the email send has succeeded. Retry 3 times with backoff, then record SEND_FAILED without claiming escalation.
deduplication: One email per session per level. A follow-up is sent only when the level rises.
